2026-06-30T06:01:10.4151770Z # wait_for_startup friendly_name host port timeout_s
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4152337Z function wait_for_startup() {
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4152769Z     local pid="$1"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4153137Z     local server_name="$2"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4153553Z     local server_url="$3"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4154055Z     local timeout_s="$4"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4154315Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4154478Z     local now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4154935Z     local stop_s=$(( $now_s + $timeout_s ))
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4155281Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4155424Z     local status
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4155640Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4155870Z     echo -n "Connecting to $server_name ($server_url)"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4156435Z     while [ $now_s -le $stop_s ]; do
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4156885Z         echo -n .
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4157328Z         process_status "$server_name" "$pid" >/dev/null
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4157872Z         if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4158332Z             echo "Starting $server_name failed"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4159270Z             return 1
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4159626Z         fi
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4159809Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4160122Z         status=`curl -o /dev/null -s -k -w %{http_code} $server_url`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4160813Z         if [[ $status -eq 200 || $status -eq 401 ]]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4161346Z             echo "OK"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4161745Z             echo "Started [pid $pid]"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4162194Z             return 0
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4162565Z         fi
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4162904Z         sleep 2
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4163254Z         now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4163648Z     done
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4163830Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4164216Z     echo "The operation timed out when attempting to connect to $server_url" >&2
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4164907Z     return 1
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4165219Z }
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4165386Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4165548Z function free_memory() {
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4165930Z     local free=""
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4166268Z     local os=`uname`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4166640Z     if [ "$os" == "Linux" ]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4167287Z         local mem_free=`cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "MemFree" | awk '{print $2}'`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4168206Z         local mem_buffer=`cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "Buffers" | awk '{print $2}'`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4169407Z         local mem_cached=`cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "Cached" | awk '{print $2}'`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4170296Z         if [[ "$mem_free" == "" || "$mem_buffer" == "" || "$mem_cached" == "" ]]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4170699Z             echo "Failed to get free memory"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4170975Z             exit 1
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4171171Z         fi
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4171407Z         free=`expr $mem_free + $mem_buffer + $mem_cached`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4171720Z         free=`expr $free / 1024`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4171971Z     elif [ "$os" == "Darwin" ]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4172421Z         local pages_free=`vm_stat | awk '/Pages free/{print $0}' | awk -F'[:.]+' '{print $2}' | tr -d " "`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4173077Z         local pages_inactive=`vm_stat | awk '/Pages inactive/{print $0}' | awk -F'[:.]+' '{print $2}' | tr -d " "`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4173630Z         local pages_available=`expr $pages_free + $pages_inactive`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4174144Z         free=`expr $pages_available \* 4096 / 1024 / 1024`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4174442Z     else
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4174659Z         echo "Unsupported operating system $os"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4174941Z         exit 1
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4175129Z     fi
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4175304Z     echo $free
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4175496Z }
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4175592Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4175685Z function calc_xmx() {
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4175903Z     local min_mem=$1
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4176111Z     local max_mem=$2
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4176328Z     # Get machine available memory
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4176595Z     local free=`free_memory`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4176837Z     local half_free=$[free/2]
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4176988Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4177076Z     local xmx=$min_mem
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4177308Z     if [[ "$free" -lt "$min_mem" ]]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4177564Z         exit 1
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4177795Z     elif [[ "$half_free" -ge "$max_mem" ]]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4178074Z         xmx=$max_mem
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4178308Z     elif [[ "$half_free" -lt "$min_mem" ]]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4178845Z         xmx=$min_mem
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4179052Z     else
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4179241Z         xmx=$half_free
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4179447Z     fi
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4179626Z     echo $xmx
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4179810Z }

2026-06-30T06:01:10.4186404Z function get_ip() {
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4186612Z     local os=`uname`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4186844Z     local loopback="127.0.0.1"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4187080Z     local ip=""

2026-06-30T06:01:10.4187460Z         Linux)

2026-06-30T06:01:10.4190099Z                 ip=$loopback
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4190335Z             fi
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4190519Z             ;;
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4190717Z         FreeBSD|OpenBSD|Darwin)
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4190982Z             if command_available "ifconfig"; then
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4191400Z                 ip=`ifconfig | grep -E 'inet.[0-9]' | grep -v "$loopback" | awk '{ print $2}'`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4191923Z             else
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4192123Z                 ip=$loopback
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4192345Z             fi
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4192539Z             ;;
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4192733Z         SunOS)
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4192952Z             if command_available "ifconfig"; then
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4193346Z                 ip=`ifconfig -a | grep inet | grep -v "$loopback" | awk '{ print $2} '`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4203368Z             else
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4203717Z                 ip=$loopback
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4203984Z             fi
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4204183Z             ;;
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4204394Z         *) ip=$loopback;;
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4204620Z     esac
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4204808Z     echo $ip
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4204994Z }

2026-06-30T06:01:10.4216224Z function wait_for_shutdown() {
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4216481Z     local process_name="$1"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4216715Z     local pid="$2"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4216920Z     local timeout_s="$3"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4217068Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4217157Z     local now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4217425Z     local stop_s=$(( $now_s + $timeout_s ))
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4217621Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4217755Z     echo -n "Killing $process_name(pid $pid)" >&2
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4218071Z     while [ $now_s -le $stop_s ]; do
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4218326Z         echo -n .
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4218814Z         process_status "$process_name" "$pid" >/dev/null
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4219316Z         if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4219553Z             echo "OK"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4219758Z             return 0
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4219962Z         fi
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4220143Z         sleep 2
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4220351Z         now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4220570Z     done
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4220860Z     echo "$process_name shutdown timeout(exceeded $timeout_s seconds)" >&2
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4221228Z     return 1
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4221414Z }
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4221513Z

2026-06-30T06:01:10.4223255Z     else
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4223489Z         echo "The process $process_name does not exist"
2026-06-30T06:01:10.4223787Z         return 1

2026-06-30T06:01:10.4224151Z }

2026-06-30T06:01:20.5073854Z # wait_for_startup friendly_name host port timeout_s
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5074312Z function wait_for_startup() {
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5074559Z     local pid="$1"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5074770Z     local server_name="$2"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5075000Z     local server_url="$3"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5075223Z     local timeout_s="$4"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5075363Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5075456Z     local now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5075714Z     local stop_s=$(( $now_s + $timeout_s ))
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5075908Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5075986Z     local status
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5076106Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5076239Z     echo -n "Connecting to $server_name ($server_url)"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5076557Z     while [ $now_s -le $stop_s ]; do
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5076812Z         echo -n .
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5077161Z         process_status "$server_name" "$pid" >/dev/null
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5077481Z         if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5077741Z             echo "Starting $server_name failed"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5078018Z             return 1
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5078212Z         fi
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5078319Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5078681Z         status=`curl -o /dev/null -s -k -w %{http_code} $server_url`
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5079071Z         if [[ $status -eq 200 || $status -eq 401 ]]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5079373Z             echo "OK"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5079599Z             echo "Started [pid $pid]"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5079854Z             return 0
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5080050Z         fi
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5080231Z         sleep 2
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5080461Z         now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5080786Z     done
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5080892Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5081110Z     echo "The operation timed out when attempting to connect to $server_url" >&2
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5081495Z     return 1
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5081676Z }
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5081780Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5081874Z function free_memory() {
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5082094Z     local free=""
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5082290Z     local os=`uname`
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5082642Z     if [ "$os" == "Linux" ]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5083022Z         local mem_free=`cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "MemFree" | awk '{print $2}'`
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5083517Z         local mem_buffer=`cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "Buffers" | awk '{print $2}'`
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5084017Z         local mem_cached=`cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "Cached" | awk '{print $2}'`
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5084481Z         if [[ "$mem_free" == "" || "$mem_buffer" == "" || "$mem_cached" == "" ]]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5085038Z             echo "Failed to get free memory"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5085312Z             exit 1
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5085504Z         fi

2026-06-30T06:01:20.5090520Z function calc_xmx() {

2026-06-30T06:01:20.5090943Z     local max_mem=$2

2026-06-30T06:01:20.5091989Z

2026-06-30T06:01:20.5093809Z     else
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5093987Z         xmx=$half_free
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5094191Z     fi
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5094366Z     echo $xmx
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5094549Z }

2026-06-30T06:01:20.5123171Z

2026-06-30T06:01:20.5123829Z     if [[ $actual_md5 != $expected_md5 ]]; then

2026-06-30T06:01:20.5125141Z     fi
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5125249Z

2026-06-30T06:01:20.5144059Z function wait_for_shutdown() {
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5144541Z     local process_name="$1"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5144990Z     local pid="$2"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5145370Z     local timeout_s="$3"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5145533Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5145629Z     local now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5145901Z     local stop_s=$(( $now_s + $timeout_s ))
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5146094Z 
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5146230Z     echo -n "Killing $process_name(pid $pid)" >&2
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5146557Z     while [ $now_s -le $stop_s ]; do
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5146809Z         echo -n .
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5147072Z         process_status "$process_name" "$pid" >/dev/null
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5147386Z         if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5147619Z             echo "OK"
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5147823Z             return 0
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5148022Z         fi
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5148216Z         sleep 2
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5148617Z         now_s=`date '+%s'`
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5148884Z     done
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5149194Z     echo "$process_name shutdown timeout(exceeded $timeout_s seconds)" >&2
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5149595Z     return 1
2026-06-30T06:01:20.5149914Z }
